scripts.typecheck: node scripts/wasm-build.mjs && tsc -b && pnpm --filter @csp/lang-wasm typecheck && pnpm --filter @csp/web typecheck && pnpm --filter @csp/balance typecheck
scripts.check: eslint . --cache --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/ && pnpm typecheck && node scripts/check-tests.mjs
scripts.test:slow: cargo nextest run --cargo-profile slow --profile slow -p csp-sim --lib --run-ignored only -E "test(/npc_slow::/) and not test(/game_year/)"
scripts.test:year: cargo nextest run --cargo-profile slow --profile slow -p csp-sim --lib --run-ignored only -E "test(/npc_slow::game_year::/)"
scripts.test:ignored: cargo nextest run --cargo-profile slow --profile ignored --workspace --run-ignored only
